resources.string: Climate and comfort through CarPlay Ultra

Debug test. Reconnect CarPlay after saving. Driver/passenger temperature, HVAC, A/C, fan, AUTO, recirculation, window defrost and comfort controls use verified OEM readback. Climate UI on iPhone is not yet confirmed.
Writes require WRITE_CANBUS. Cabin sensor, MAX A/C and radio are not advertised. Commands run only in response to an explicit iPhone request.
